notes: TIER USED: Direct HTTP fetch (curl) only, tier 1 — SSR HTML fully returned real data, no JS-rendering block encountered, so Playwright/Chrome were not needed. robots.txt checked first: standard 'User-agent: *' / 'Allow: /' with only tracking/param/session paths disallowed; no Claude-specific disallow — access unrestricted. METHOD: pulled the site's own embedded navigation JSON (window.__myx_navigationData__) from the Home & Living page HTML and walked the full 'Home' branch of the real taxonomy tree: Bed Linen & Furnishing, Flooring, Bath, Lamps & Lighting, Home Decor (Plants/Aromas/Clocks/Mirrors/Wall Decor/Festive Decor/Pooja Essentials/Wall Shelves/Fountains/Showpieces/Ottoman), Cushions & Cushion Covers, Curtains, Furniture, Home Gift Sets, Kitchen & Table, Storage, Brands. NONE of these live nav entries are named after a specific holiday — no Diwali, Christmas, Halloween, Easter, Thanksgiving, New Year, Holi, Raksha Bandhan, Eid, Valentine's Day, Mother's/Father's Day node exists in the real menu. 'Diwan Sets' under Bed Linen is a furniture false-positive (diwan = day-bed), unrelated to Diwali. CLOSEST CANDIDATE — 'Festive Decor': this IS a genuine structured taxonomy leaf (masterCategory:Home > subCategory:Home Decor > articleType:Festive Decor), nav-linked, canonical URL https://www.myntra.com/festive-decor with a proper 3-level breadcrumb (Home > Home Furnishing > Festive Decor) and a stable displayed count of 11,127 (verified identical whether reached via the nav's own '?f=Categories:Festive Decor' query or the canonical slug). But it is explicitly a MULTI-OCCASION umbrella, not holiday-branded: its own 'Theme' filter facet breaks it into Christmas(1161)/Diwali(672)/Holi(202)/NewYear(230)/Valentine's(~150)/NA(5606, untagged), and sample listed products include wedding-stage backdrops and generic party decor alongside diyas/torans — the site itself does not brand this node as any single holiday, so it fails the 'branded holiday-specific' test and is excluded as a row (documented as evidence, not counted). The 'Theme' facet itself is genuine structured product metadata (not fuzzy search) but is only a secondary filter dimension inside the generic Home Furnishing search — applying it (e.g. ?f=Theme:Diwali, count 9,604 sitewide) never produces its own breadcrumb node (stays 'Home > Home Furnishing') and is not surfaced anywhere in the site's own navigation UI, so it does not meet the stable-category-node bar either. SEARCH-ALIAS PAGES RULED OUT: probed direct URL slugs /diwali, /diwali-decor, /diwali-home-decor, /diwali-decoration, /christmas-decor, /christmas-decorations, /new-year-decor, /holi, /rakhi — all return HTTP 200 with an auto-generated SEO template ('Buy X Online in India') and a breadcrumb dynamically title-cased from the URL slug itself. Proved this is NOT real taxonomy three ways: (1) a fabricated nonsense slug '/diwali-home-decor-fake-test' also produced a fully-dressed branded page with its own synthetic breadcrumb and a nonzero result count; (2) truly random slugs ('/xyzqwerty123nonsense') fell back to a bare 'Search' title with 0 results, confirming the mechanism is keyword/text matching, only cosmetically dressed when the slug parses as real words; (3) cross-checking results proved text-relevance pollution — '/christmas-decor' and '/christmas-decorations' returned byte-identical result sets (both count 2328) whose top hits included a 'Holi Water Balloons' item and a 'Baby Shower Festive Decor' item, i.e. NOT Christmas-specific inventory; '/diwali-decor' and '/diwali-decoration' likewise returned identical sets (both count 34251) of generically-tagged 'Festive Decor' products. Bare hub pages /diwali (count 59,197), /holi (297), /rakhi (58,838) resolve to only a 2-level breadcrumb ('Home > Diwali' etc.) spanning the ENTIRE Myntra site (fashion+beauty+home combined) — these are cross-department sale/search hubs, out of Home & Living scope and excluded as marketing pages per task rules, not genuine Home & Living category pages. Also checked 'Home Gift Sets' (count 8,057) — generic occasion-agnostic gifting category, no holiday sub-nodes — and 'Pooja Essentials' — genuine year-round daily-worship-items category (not seasonal, same class as a routine Kitchen/Bath category). CONCLUSION: Myntra Home & Living's real taxonomy (as reflected in its own site navigation and canonical breadcrumb structure) contains no genuine holiday-specific product category. Everything that superficially looks like Diwali/Christmas/Holi/New Year shopping is either (a) the generic multi-occasion 'Festive Decor' articleType, (b) a non-branded internal facet ('Theme'), or (c) an auto-generated search-alias SEO landing page — none of which meet the genuine-PLP bar. status set to no_seasonal, rows empty.
